vent-brush.context: A hairbrush with a wide oval head cut by open slots and a tapered handle. Used for blow drying, quick styling and detangling in salon, grooming and hair care contexts.

edge-brush.context: A slim double ended grooming tool with a small bristle brush at one end and a fine comb at the other, drawn on a diagonal. Used for smoothing edges, baby hairs and neat hairlines.

hair-crimper.context: A hinged styling iron whose two long plates are cut in a zigzag and open slightly above a short handle. Used for crimping hair into tight waves and adding texture.

hair-bonnet.context: A puffy round sleep bonnet seen from the side with a gathered band along its lower edge. Used to protect hair overnight, keep curls and braids in place and reduce frizz.

sectioning-clip.context: A long narrow duckbill clip with closed jaws and a small hinge bump at the back. Used by stylists to hold sections of hair apart while cutting, colouring or setting.

banana-clip.context: A long curved comb clip shaped like a banana with a row of teeth along its inner edge. Used to hold long hair in a vertical twist or updo.

hair-fork.context: A two pronged hair pin with long straight tines under a rounded decorative top. Used to hold buns, twists and updos in place without hair ties.

hair-donut.context: A thick ring of mesh sponge drawn at an angle with a dotted texture. Used as a form to build a neat round bun or top knot.

neck-duster.context: A round fat brush of soft bristles fanning from a short handle. Used by barbers to sweep cut hair and powder from the neck and face after a haircut.

tint-bowl.context: A shallow colour mixing bowl with a grip tab and a flat tint brush resting across it. Used by stylists to mix and apply hair dye and bleach.

color-swatch-ring.context: A fan of three hair colour swatch locks hanging from a single ring. Used in salons to compare and choose a hair shade.

hair-color-applicator-bottle.context: A squeeze bottle with measuring marks on its side and a long tapered nozzle. Used to apply hair dye directly to the roots and scalp.

clipper-guard.context: A clip on guard comb with a curved spine, four long teeth and a hole for the length number. Fits over clippers to set the cutting length.

razor-strop.context: A leather strap hanging from a hook with a handle at the bottom end. Used to hone and polish the edge of a straight razor before shaving.

shaving-stand.context: A pedestal stand holding a shaving brush and a safety razor from a crossbar. Used to dry and display wet shaving gear on a bathroom counter.

beard-shaping-tool.context: A curved beard line template shaped like a U with three guide teeth. Held against the face as a guide when trimming a neat beard outline.

beard-bib.context: A barber apron with a curved neck cutout and a suction cup at each upper corner. Sticks to a mirror under the chin to catch trimmed beard hair.

comb-disinfectant-jar.context: A tall lidded jar of blue style liquid with two combs standing in it. Used in barbershops and salons to disinfect combs and tools between clients.

shears-holster.context: A leather pouch with two slots, one holding hair shears by their finger rings and one holding a comb. Worn on a belt by hairdressers.

hair-mousse.context: An aerosol can with a nozzle cap and a cloud of foam beside it. Used to add volume, hold and curl definition when styling.

pressing-comb.context: A metal comb with wide teeth and a handle, with wavy heat lines above it. Heated to straighten and smooth hair, as in a press and curl.

hair-twist-sponge.context: A rectangular sponge pad covered in round holes beside a coil of curly hair. Rubbed over short hair to form tight coils and twists.

peineta-comb.context: A tall ornamental hair comb with an arched crown and short teeth along the bottom. Worn upright behind a bun in Spanish and bridal styles.

hair-clippings.context: A small mound of cut hair on the floor with a pair of scissors lying beside it. Used for haircut, trim and barbershop cleanup contexts.

uv-sterilizer-cabinet.context: A small cabinet with a glass door, a tube lamp at the top with short rays and a shelf below. Used to disinfect salon tools with ultraviolet light.

towel-warmer-cabinet.context: A box cabinet holding stacked folded towels with wavy steam lines rising above it. Keeps hot towels ready for shaves, facials and spa treatments.

rolling-stool.context: A round padded stool on a single column with a five caster wheel base. Used by stylists, technicians and artists who move around a client.

salon-styling-chair.context: A front view of a salon chair with a rounded back, armrests, a column and a round base. Used where clients sit for haircuts, colour and styling.

salon-trolley.context: A narrow rolling cart with three trays holding a bottle, on small wheels. Keeps colour bottles, brushes and tools within reach beside the stylist.

styling-station.context: A wall mirror above a narrow counter with a chair back in front of it. Marks a stylist's workstation in a hair salon or barbershop.

magnifying-lamp.context: A round magnifier lamp with a lens ring on a jointed arm and a clamp base. Used by estheticians and lash and nail artists to see fine detail.

french-manicure.context: A fingertip with a long nail whose free edge is marked by a curved band. Used for classic white tip nails, nail salons and bridal nail art.

nail-drill.context: A slim electric file handpiece with a small bit at the tip and a cord from the back. Used by nail technicians to shape, prep and remove acrylic and gel.

dappen-dish.context: A small glass dish on a thick base with a nail brush resting across its rim. Holds acrylic liquid for dipping the brush when building nails.

nail-dust-collector.context: A low box with a cushioned hand rest on top and a fan seen through the front vent. Pulls filing dust away from the client at a nail table.

manicure-bowl.context: A curved fingertip bowl with four fingers dipping into the water. Used to soak and soften the nails and cuticles before a manicure.

pedicure-chair.context: A side view of a padded high backed chair with an armrest and a foot basin built into the front. Used in nail salons and spas for foot treatments.

nail-swatch-wheel.context: A round display wheel with six false nail tips arranged around its edge. Used to preview polish colours and nail designs.

dotting-tool.context: A slim double ended stick with a ball at each end and a dot of polish beside one tip. Used for nail art dots, flowers and small details.

bob-haircut.context: A front view of a head with straight chin length hair cut level all around the face. Used for haircut, stylist and salon topics.

bangs-hairstyle.context: A front view of a head with long straight hair and a blunt fringe across the forehead. Used for hairstyle, haircut and salon topics.

buzz-cut.context: A front view of a head with hair clipped very short and even, shown as a thin cap with a few dots. Used for barber, military and low maintenance haircut topics.

flat-top-haircut.context: A front view of a head with short sides and a tall block of hair with a perfectly level top. Used for barber and retro haircut topics.

spiky-hair.context: A front view of a head with short hair styled into sharp upward spikes. Used for punk, gel styled and playful hairstyle topics.

side-part-hairstyle.context: A front view of a head with short neat hair combed across from a clear parting line. Used for classic barber and business look topics.

bowl-cut.context: A front view of a head with an even rounded cap of hair, a straight fringe and a level edge all around. Used for kids haircut and retro hairstyle topics.

bald-head.context: A front view of a smooth bald head and shoulders with a small shine mark on top. Used for baldness, hair loss and shaved head topics.

comb-over.context: A front view of a bald head with two long strands of hair combed across the crown. Used for thinning hair and balding jokes and topics.

sideburns.context: A front view of a face with thick wide sideburns running down the cheeks from the ears to the jaw. Used for facial hair, barber and retro style topics.

chin-strap-beard.context: A front view of a face with a thin line of beard following the jaw from ear to ear and no mustache. Used for facial hair and grooming topics.

pigtails.context: A front view of a head with a centre parting and two bunches of hair sticking out low on each side. Used for girl and kids hairstyle topics.

space-buns.context: A front view of a head with two round buns sitting high on either side of the top of the head. Used for festival, kids and playful hairstyle topics.

dreadlocks.context: A front view of a head with long rope like locks hanging past the shoulders on each side of the face. Used for locs and natural hairstyle topics.

afro-hairstyle.context: A front view of a head with a large rounded halo of textured hair around the face and above the head. Used for natural hair and 1970s style topics.

box-braids.context: A front view of a head with many long thin braids hanging straight down past the shoulders. Used for protective style and braiding salon topics.

bantu-knots.context: A front view of a head with a row of small coiled knots set evenly around the crown. Used for natural hair and protective style topics.

french-braid.context: A back view of a head with a braid woven close to the scalp in V shapes then hanging down in a plait. Used for braided hairstyle topics.

french-twist.context: A back view of a head with the hair twisted into a vertical roll up the middle and held with a pin. Used for formal and wedding hairstyle topics.

half-up-half-down.context: A back view of a head with the upper section tied in a small knot and the rest of the hair hanging loose. Used for casual hairstyle topics.

cornrows.context: A top view of a head with three parallel tight braids running from the forehead to the nape. Used for braided and protective hairstyle topics.

hair-transplant.context: A top view of a head with a neat grid of tiny implanted dots across the front hairline. Used for hair restoration and clinic topics.

pixie-cut.context: A side view of a head with very short cropped hair and a small swept fringe over the forehead. Used for short women's haircut topics.

undercut-hairstyle.context: A side view of a head with long hair on top swept back and the sides and back shaved short below a sharp line. Used for barber and men's hairstyle topics.

mohawk-hairstyle.context: A side view of a head with shaved sides and a tall strip of spiked hair from the forehead to the nape. Used for punk and bold hairstyle topics.

pompadour.context: A side view of a head with hair swept up high and back from the forehead in a big rolled wave, short at the sides. Used for retro and barber topics.

mullet.context: A side view of a head with short hair on top and sides and long hair hanging down over the back of the neck. Used for retro haircut topics.

man-bun.context: A side view of a head with hair pulled back tight into a round bun at the crown and a short beard. Used for men's long hair and hipster topics.

slicked-back-hair.context: A side view of a head with hair combed flat straight back from the forehead in smooth parallel lines. Used for gelled and gentleman style topics.

beehive-hairdo.context: A side view of a head with hair piled into a tall rounded cone on top, smooth at the sides. Used for 1960s and retro hairstyle topics.

fade-haircut.context: A side view of a head with short hair on top that fades to bare skin at the sides, shown by shrinking dots. Used for barber haircut topics.

finger-waves.context: A side view of a head with short hair set into flat S shaped ridged waves across the head. Used for 1920s and vintage hairstyle topics.

hair-perm.context: A side view of a head with rows of small perm rods wound tight across the hair. Used for perm, curling and salon treatment topics.

hair-foils.context: A side view of a head with several folded foil packets lying in layers across the hair. Used for highlights, balayage and colour topics at the salon.

highlighting-cap.context: A front view of a head in a snug cap dotted with holes, strands pulled through them and a hook tool beside it. Used for frosted streak colouring topics.

pencil-mustache.context: A lower face with a very thin narrow line mustache just above the upper lip, split by a small gap. Used for retro and gentleman grooming topics.

walrus-mustache.context: A lower face with a thick bushy mustache that droops over the whole upper lip and past the mouth corners. Used for facial hair and grooming topics.

horseshoe-mustache.context: A lower face with a mustache running down both sides of the mouth to the jaw in an upside down U. Used for biker and retro facial hair topics.

soul-patch.context: A lower face with a small tuft of hair just below the lower lip and no other facial hair. Used for facial hair and jazz style topics.

van-dyke-beard.context: A lower face with an upturned mustache and a separate pointed goatee on the chin, cheeks bare. Used for facial hair and classic style topics.
